Jimothy Strides up to his Speed. During this movement, he can try to move through the space of one enemy and take a small object from them. Jimothy attempts a Stealth check against the enemy's Reflex DC as soon as he tries to enter its space.

Critical Success Jimothy moves through the enemy's space and takes an object of negligible Bulk from the enemy that is worn but not closely guarded (such as a pouch). Jimothy must have a free hand to take the object. If he doesn't have enough Speed to move all the way through its space, Jimothy gets the same effect as a failure.

Success As critical success, but Jimothy treats the squares in the enemy's space as difficult terrain (every 5 feet costs 10 feet of movement).

Failure Jimothy's movement ends, and he triggers reactions as if he had moved out of the square he started in.

Critical Failure As failure, but Jimothy also then falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
